about_the_game:
This Prologue is a limited version of the full game, giving you the chance to stop waiting and start your guild hall management today. Don’t forget to wishlist the full game to continue your heroic journey and build the greatest adventuring guild the world has ever seen.

Guild Management

Design your guild layout, placing crafting stations, training areas, taverns, and research rooms. Optimize your space to support growth for completing the potential Quests ranging from G rank to SSS rank, need to do proper power readings to unlock the adventurers real potential.

Economy

Start your own guild from no fame, no money. Set item prices, manage your economy, and ensure your guild stays profitable—even under pressure.

Continue the Adventurer with us!

Wishlist the full game Guild Hall Simulator, where your choices matter. Will your guild thrive and become the last beacon of hope in a world overrun by monsters—or crumble under the weight of your ambition?

Full version extras to look forward to

Start the Guild from Rubble in an abandoned adventurer town. Gather materials from the surrounding lands through mining, farming, and logging.

Craft rare weapons, forge armor, and produce powerful potions.

Train Adventurers which doesn't meet quest requirements.

Defend against monsters attacking the town and automate the full process while running your Guild and keeping everyones belly happy at the tavern while doing questing.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480

short_description: Build your guild. Shape your story. In Guild Hall Simulator, you don’t slay dragons—you send others to do it. Assign quests, manage gold, grow your hall, and deal with adventurers who drink too much. Will your guild rise to legendary fame, or collapse under the chaos of paperwork and slimes?
